checked_by: T-0019, the provenance sweep under ADR-0006 decision 7
method: Read the pack's whole read surface (PACK.md, CHECKS.md, guides/, refs/, exemplars/; research/ excluded as working notes) and compared each cited EV id against its row in registry/evidence.json. No source was re-fetched, so nothing here is a fresh licence check: every licence claim below is the ledger's own recorded value, read back. Quotation was checked three ways: every quotation-marked span in the read surface was listed and read; every enumeration or coined term that could only have come from a source was traced to the row that supplies it; and the rows whose ledger licence forbids reuse of wording were read against the prose that cites them. What this method cannot do is detect an unmarked sentence copied from a source nobody has the text of, and no claim of completeness is made on that.

licence_unknown.licence_recorded: unknown (repository licence file not inspected; repo commonly Apache-2.0 or CC-BY-4.0)
unknown (spec text served under an Open Web Foundation agreement; licence page not retrieved)

quotation_concerns.concern: D10 reproduces two toolchain vocabularies verbatim: FILE, PACKAGE, WIRE_JSON, WIRE from buf (EV-0135) and BACKWARD, FORWARD, FULL, NONE from the schema registry (EV-0139).
quotation_concerns.resolution: Not a concern. These are identifier values a reader has to type exactly, not expression, and both are attributed. Left as is.

notes: Twenty-two of thirty-three cited rows carry a definite licence. Seven record that the source states none, each checked. The residual is four rows whose licence string says outright that nobody inspected it: EV-0125, EV-0131, EV-0132 and EV-0140. Three of those are public GitHub repositories, so the check is cheap and is the first thing to do when this pack is next opened. EV-0140 is a specification served under an Open Web Foundation agreement whose licence page was never retrieved. No quotation concern beyond the vocabulary note below. A row marked states-none carries licence_evidence and a licence_checked date in the ledger, so somebody looked and recorded that the source states no licence. A row marked unconfirmed carries a hedged licence string and no licence_evidence, so nobody has looked. Both belong on the residual list ADR-0006 decision 7 asks for, and the difference between them is the difference between a recorded fact and a guess.
